blocks.title: How a change lands on TEVM

cards.title: 1. File a repro or pick a public TODO
cards.text: Create issues, TODOs, and artifacts through the Smithers Cloud MCP server with minimal failing reproduction steps.

cards.title: 2. Run untrusted checks freely
cards.text: Non-maintainers are encouraged to run tests locally or in untrusted sandboxes with read-only shared cache access. Untrusted runs never write the cache or skip gates.

cards.title: 3. Pass Lighthouse backpressure
cards.text: Every PR is audited by Uphill across Footprint, Quality, Architecture, and Factory Health plus regression proof and RPC wire contract checks.

cards.title: 4. Maintainer merge ships automatically
cards.text: Only a maintainer approves and merges. Merging to main on Smithers Cloud mirrors to GitHub and triggers releases, docs publishing, and wiki refresh.

blocks.title: TEVM
blocks.tagline: In-memory Ethereum Virtual Machine and full node for TypeScript, powered by Zig (ZEVM) and native Viem.
blocks.text: Deploy contracts, fork mainnet, inspect opcodes, and run Ethereum specs at native speed in Node, Bun, and browsers. Built publicly on Smithers Cloud.
